cases.contract: Independent children finish out of launch order. Preserve task-to-result identity, join all children, count every admitted request exactly once, and report wall time rather than summed overlapping request time.

cases.offline_collector_oracle: Interleaved distinct child IDs and request IDs reconcile to the exact sum.

cases.native_oracle: Interrupt a disposable runner process at the persistence barrier; inspect durable artifacts and ensure no duplicate external work on resume.
